scripts.build: pnpm --dir shared typecheck && pnpm --dir client build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir client lint && pnpm --dir client exec eslint ../shared/src --ext .ts --config .eslintrc.cjs --max-warnings 0 && node server/scripts/check-syntax.js
scripts.test: pnpm --dir shared test && pnpm --dir client test && pnpm --dir server test
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run build
